title: Culture and expansion of OT-1 TCR transgenic T cells
protocol: Plate out 100,000 SAMBOK APCs per well in a 12 well plate two days prior to your experiment.
Collect spleen and lymph nodes from CD8+OT-1 TCR transgenic mice on the day of the experiment.
Make single cell suspensions from collected cells and pool them.
Keep pooled cells at 2 X 10^7 /ml in complete media for primary splenic cultures.
Wash SAMBOK APCs once with PBS to remove any residual media and IFN-g.
Place 1 mL of cell suspension onto the SAMBOK APCs and culture for 48 hours.
Add an additional 1 ml of media to each well after 24 hours of initial incubation.
Pool all cells, spin them down in a 50 mL conical tube, and resuspend in complete media supplemented with 200 U/ml IL-2 at 2 X 10^7 /ml.
Allow the resuspended cells to sit for an additional 48 hours in a 24 well plate (1 ml/well).
Take some cells after 48 hours for FACs analysis to check purity of the population.
